feedback.answered: The legacy peers-file readers are mapped and validated. ReadPeersJSON reads a file, decodes a JSON list of address strings, maps each to a Voter whose ID equals its address, and rejects the result through checkConfiguration before returning (peersjson.go 18-45); ReadConfigJSON decodes the new-style entry list with id, address and non_voter fields, maps non_voter to the Nonvoter suffrage and everything else to Voter, and then applies the same checkConfiguration gate (peersjson.go 48-110). So neither reader can return a configuration that later fails checkConfiguration through this path: empty IDs or addresses, duplicate IDs or addresses, and a voter-less configuration are all rejected with an error before the caller sees a Configuration.
